items.title: ENA unlock: 93,750,000 ENA (0.625% of supply) · Core contributors (30% of supply) + amount not published · Investors
items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.
items.sizeText: about $9.7M at today’s price · 0.69% of circulating supply · 0.049 days of trading volume

items.sizeText: about $9.7M at today’s price · 0.69% of circulating supply · 0.049 days of trading volume

items.title: MORPHO: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends; Strategic partners, cohort 3: vesting ends
items.summary: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

headlines.title: Franklin Templeton makes room for HYPE in crypto index ETF
headlines.summary: The addition comes as US spot investment products tracking Hyperliquid’s native token reach $266.5 million in assets under management.

headlines.title: World Liberty-Linked Wallet Swaps WETH and mETH for $20M in Stablecoins
headlines.summary: The wallet showed zero balances of native ETH, WETH and mETH after the trades. It sent about 16.59 million USDC to the lending protocol Dolomite.

headlines.title: XRP Ledger Lending Clears Vote Threshold, Eyes Dec. 11
headlines.summary: Both lending amendments drew 29 yes votes in XRPSCAN’s tally. The vaults that would fund the loans could go live Dec. 9 if their support holds.

headlines.title: UAE Issues Its First Dirham-Denominated Digital Treasury Bonds via Euroclear
headlines.summary: Six primary dealers split the AED 180 million issue, which matched the 4.98% yield on the UAE’s conventional Treasury bonds sold at its November auction.

headlines.title: Binance to launch tokenized IPO program after regulatory approval: Yi He
headlines.summary: Binance is hiring for equity capital markets roles, including an analyst to develop tokenized equity products and assess prospective issuers.

headlines.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
headlines.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

headlines.title: Spark Says It Repaid Sky $408M After USDS Outflows
headlines.summary: A Morpho vault on Base supplied about four-fifths of the $416.1 million Spark freed up. The vault had less USDC available for withdrawals by the evening of Nov. 19.

headlines.title: Brazil’s stock exchange pushes stablecoin launch back to 2027
headlines.summary: Brazil’s stock exchange is working with six major financial institutions on a real-backed stablecoin that could launch as early as the first quarter of 2027.

headlines.title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
headlines.summary: Pablo Hernández de Cos, chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors blockchain-based banking and has warned against private digital currencies and banks holding bitcoin.

headlines.title: Injective asks SEC to allow order books for tokenized stock trading
headlines.summary: The regulator's rules favor one type of blockchain trading system, leaving platforms built on Injective out, the developer said. It wants the SEC to open stock trading to order-book systems.

headlines.title: Brazil’s B3 and Six Firms Plan Real-Backed Stablecoin
headlines.summary: Banco B3 would hold one real for each Open BRL token. The platform, designed to settle digital-asset trades, is targeting the first quarter of 2027.

headlines.title: Brazil’s stock exchange teams up with major banks to launch real-pegged stablecoin
headlines.summary: Banco B3 will issue the token, backed one-to-one by reais, and other financial institutions can join from launch.

headlines.title: Bank of Japan official says stablecoins need reserve rules to preserve ‘singleness of money’
headlines.summary: Japan’s central bank warned that stablecoins and tokenized deposits need safeguards to prevent fragmentation across the financial system.

headlines.title: Bluefin to shut down perps, refocus on spot trading and tokenized RWAs
headlines.summary: Bluefin will close its perps platform on Dec. 4, exiting a shrinking Sui market where it once handled over $500 million in daily trades.

headlines.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
headlines.summary: The vaults that would hold lenders' money are on track to switch on Dec. 9. The loan system that draws from them still needs one more validator to start its own two-week clock.

headlines.title: Bluefin to Shut Down Perpetual Futures on Sui Dec. 4
headlines.summary: Bluefin told traders to close positions before 4 p.m. ET. Aftermath Finance and DipCoin each handled more Sui perps volume than Bluefin in DefiLlama’s 30-day snapshot.

headlines.title: UK is ‘getting it wrong’ on DeFi regulation, says Coinbase
headlines.summary: Coinbase and Stand With Crypto argue that the FCA’s proposed DeFi rules could leave UK users without regulated access to decentralized finance.

headlines.title: Fluid Pauses DEX Swaps After ‘Mythos 5.2’ Security Review
headlines.summary: The protocol says borrowers can still repay loans and users can still withdraw funds. It gave no date for trading to resume.

headlines.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
headlines.summary: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.

headlines.title: Tokenized Anthropic Holders Doubled in 3 Days
headlines.summary: The Cash Leg Moves Onchain An onchain trade requires both the tokenized asset itself and an onchain payment that clears it. Most of this year’s progress has been focused on the asset. Last week bank money started to move onchain too. Last…

headlines.title: Ethena Says sUSDe Wait Is Gone; Early Checks Read One Day
headlines.summary: Ethena’s risk committee backed instant unstaking with safeguards. Two Ethereum explorer checks minutes after the announcement returned a 24-hour cooldown setting without identifying a block.

headlines.title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
headlines.summary: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.

headlines.title: Extended Sets XTEN Airdrop for Nov. 29 Ahead of Trading
headlines.summary: Eligible points holders must sign before 3:30 a.m. ET on Nov. 29 and clear checks in time for the first batch. Vault depositors will need to stake XTEN to earn Extra Yield.

headlines.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
headlines.summary: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

headlines.title: UK Regulator Cites Binance Hack as It Plans Tougher DeFi Rules Than US and EU: Report
headlines.summary: The FCA plans to require DeFi platforms to be authorized and to keep regulated exchanges from routing UK retail trades to them.

headlines.title: Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
headlines.summary: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

headlines.title: Japan Weighs Rules for DeFi Access and Self-Custody
headlines.summary: The Financial Services Agency asks whether to deter access to DeFi without anti-money-laundering controls and how to curb illicit finance when no responsible party can be identified.

headlines.title: b14g’s Recorded TVL Nearly Halved to $135M by Nov. 24
headlines.summary: DefiLlama’s recorded Bitcoin balance fell 31% over 30 days, while its implied dollar value per coin fell about 24%.

headlines.title: Sky Proposes Urgent 25M USDS Transfer to Foundation
headlines.summary: The funds were already earmarked for the Sky Frontier Foundation. The proposal seeks to accelerate debt repayment as stUSDS withdrawals remain unavailable.

headlines.title: Convex TVL Falls 33%, More Than Twice Curve's Decline
headlines.summary: DefiLlama's daily snapshots show a $188 million contraction over 30 days. The change in dollar value is not a measure of withdrawals.
